propositions: Detached pytest runs via nohup report test failures that do not reproduce in foreground runs, but detachment alone does not cause the failures.

The true cause is concurrent external mutation of the shared checkout (file creation, HEAD moves, process reaping) during test execution, which only occurs in detached mode because foreground runs block the mutating agent.
The `_no_repo_root_leaks` guard attributes external filesystem mutations to innocent tests and deletes concurrent agent files without distinguishing test-caused from externally-caused changes.
The `tests/e2e/conftest.py` browser probe diagnostic reports empty stderr when the child is signal-killed but never inspects `proc.returncode`, masking external reaping as a product failure.

Detached runs are trustworthy when no concurrent mutation occurs; the remedy is isolation documentation and honest guard diagnostics that name external-cause possibilities rather than adding detachment-keyed skips that suppress real signals.
